changes: Compact exact SIMD operand normalization: magnitude MIN plus threshold maps all IEEE input bits identically to the prior normalizer.
One biased signed comparison for ordinary classes; XOR positive saturation; immediate-mask lane merging.
Original floating arithmetic order, flags, interlocks, cycles and packet timing retained. Public interpreter header and object layout unchanged.
Shared cold flags, AVX dispatch and packet batching experiments are excluded. Existing settings and original-30 controls retained.

raw_benchmark.settings: 4x internal, 3840x2160 window target, audio on, uncapped; DLSS/neural/water/rays/FG/VSync/cap off

enhanced_benchmark.settings: Same resolution/audio/rate; DLSS quality, neural rendering, modern water, ray reflections/shadows on; FG off
enhanced_benchmark.conclusion: Single control/candidate pair remains about 27 FPS; no material enhanced gain established.

validation.visual: Final enhanced world, character, HUD and water inspected
validation.release_build: Full Release SSE vector program rebuilt, including all four generated image slices and both existing native kernels. No reused AOT objects. Only private operand helpers and regression targets change; no public interpreter layout or header change.
validation.normal_build_override: removed; full-bin output and normal linker flags restored
